messages:
olivia: postmortem follow-up  three rollouts showed the same cascade: flag A ramps, background jobs hit new code path, downstream flag B fails. need ownership + dependency checks.
raj: agree. propose we add explicit dependencies[] and a flag DAG validator before any step >0. quick schema change.
marcus: also build a small simulator that can run a rollout DAG and replay batch-job traffic to measure collision risk. want a local harness + CI job.
sara: auto-rollback rules: step_back one level when error_rate_delta > 1.0% with min_events 500. but we must cap automated change so blast_radius_auto <= 10%. manual quarantine button in console to freeze ramp to safe fraction.
lina_pm: PM will own the remediation board and track deliverables. need clear deadlines.
olivia: owners/ETA: raj schema + DAG validator (3 days); marcus simulator + CI check (2w); sara rollback engine + console button (1w); eng-sre assist with sampling and runbook (1w).
eng-sre: will add higher sampling for flagged flows and help validate simulator signals.
marcus: simulator will include dependency scenarios and a chaos-mode that flips dependent flags to verify no orphaned states. will add a deterministic seed for reproducibility.
raj: example flag metadata we'll add to registry: {"owner":"team-a","risk":"high","dependencies":["flag-b","flag-c"]} (will open GH PR).
sara: rollback safety: add a pre-check to prevent auto-step that would reduce availability of a dependent service below threshold. simulator to validate.
olivia: recurrence detector idea: lightweight classifier that looks for correlated spikes across flags + job windows; surface a "flag risk" tag in console. POC in 3w.
lina_pm: PM will add OKR to reduce rollout-induced incidents by 30% this quarter and will track MTTR for rollouts.
deploy-bot: [bot] created ticket RF-5220 "rollout/dependency safety: DAG validator, simulator, rollback engine" assigned to raj, marcus, sara, olivia.
olivia: quick decision: enforcement policy on controller will be opt-in for 2 weeks then enforced org-wide. update ticket if you need to reassign. sync Fri 10am.
